qualification: Three compact authored sparse MIDI probes panic in u64 multiplication before clock division. Two PPQ32767 clocks are representable after division; PPQ1 exceeds u64 microseconds. Both within-segment and tempo-map accumulation paths reproduce.

Shared u128 advancement divides before checked narrowing to u64 and adds the segment start safely. Parser maps/segment construction propagate precise errors. Valid divided times preserve exact existing per-segment rounding; unrepresentable times refuse instead of panic or wrapping.

Long probes are parsed only and are not rendered or claimed as short/real playback acceptance. A normal100ms authored note plus release is natively decoded and played/rewound/EOF-seeked; a separate short authored VP9/PCM companion decodes natively. No FFmpeg/network/private media needed.

17 MIDI parser/5 MIDI reader tests, related synthesis-clock/seek/duration integrations, fixture reproducibility and player build pass. No release/32bit runtime, physical output, performance or unlimited-duration playback claim.
compatibility: Valid long clocks whose divided result fits the existing representation parse correctly; unrepresentable MIDI timelines now return an explicit range error. Public interfaces and ordinary clocks remain unchanged.
counting: One MIDI clock product overflow problem in two arithmetic paths; representability cases and controls add no IDs.
